reason: My guests pay a lot for a villa week and they get me, not a robot; answering them myself, even at midnight, is the hospitality. The price is nothing, but a QR card in my villa tells them I don't have time for them.
objection: A machine answering my guests makes the villa feel like a cheap apartment block, and I'm still not sure what happens to their messages and names once some AI company has them, signed paper or not.
would_change_my_mind: If another villa owner I respect on this coast used it all summer and told me her guests liked it and it only took the Wi-Fi and parking questions while I was abroad, I would try it for the weeks I'm away.
